metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage at a sampling rate of 256 Hz with 60 Hz line frequency filtering. Participants performed a P300 speller task with a 9x8 checkerboard stimulus grid under gaze conditions. Each subject completed one session with target and non-target visual stimuli presented in a calibration-then-test cross-validation design with online feedback.
